استمنين (form X)
# اِسْتَمْنَيْنَ (istamnayna) /is.tam.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
# اِسْتَمْنِينَ (istamnīna) /is.tam.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
